name: Agentic LangGraph + CrewAI + FastAPI
note: Each task runs a real command. Token figures are not recorded here; evals/runner.py measures context cost directly. The search tool is deterministic and the graph is pure Python, so no LLM key, Redis or network is needed. The pinned crewai package could not be installed here (its litellm dependency needs a Rust toolchain) and the starter does not import it, so CrewAI delegation is not verified. SEC-04, SEC-07 and SEC-09 have no starter code and are not asserted by tests.

eval_tasks.title: Service boots and reports health
eval_tasks.instruction: The FastAPI app and the compiled LangGraph must import and answer the health probe.
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests/test_api.py -k health -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: Agent graph runs to a report
eval_tasks.instruction: The research and synthesis graph must terminate and the endpoint must return the synthesized report.
assertions: graph invocation terminates with a report
the router stops after three iterations
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests/test_graph.py tests/test_api.py -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: Declared security controls hold under test
eval_tasks.instruction: Run the suite covering the cycle limit, strict input validation, tool sandboxing, credential hygiene, closed CORS, error disclosure and container user/PATH.
assertions: a never-ending graph is stopped by the recursion limit and the API fails closed
unknown fields and out-of-range queries return 422
the search tool imports no host-reaching modules and bounds its output
no API key literal in source or compose
cross-origin requests get no CORS grant
exception text never reaches the caller
Dockerfile user is not root and PATH keeps the system path
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests/test_security.py -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: Full suite green
eval_tasks.instruction: The complete functional and security suite passes.
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests/ -q -p no:warnings
